reuse.why: Changes the rule in the existing getRangedAmount helper and routes the one site that computed its own midpoint (schedule-template) through it.

duplication.why: Removes the inline midpoint copy in schedule-template; no new duplicated logic.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, where the tree defines the ranged-amount semantics used by server and client.

scope.why: A one-line rule change, one call-site consolidation, comment updates and a focused test (plus a conventional release note).

maintainability.why: Any future change to the ranged-amount rule is again a one-line edit in one helper that every path uses.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No bypass; the previously bypassing schedule-template site now uses getRangedAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the per-site missing/number dispatch around getRangedAmount is pre-existing and untouched.

one_place.where: getRangedAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getScheduledAmount, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), forecast-schedules and now schedule-template.
